title: Crew reports a weather delay; auto-send on
expected: Crew report a weather delay with auto-send on: the delay update goes automatically to the BED FBO; nothing goes automatically to the client.

email.subject: Weather hold at TEB
email.body:
Ops,

Fog at Teterboro this morning. We're on a ground hold and expect to depart for Bedford at 08:45 instead of 08:00. Passengers are in the lounge and know about the delay.

Dana Whitlock
Captain, N307LH
